title: lagerstroemia subcostata var. fauriei
intro: Lagerstroemia subcostata var. fauriei, commonly known as Korean cranesbill, is a plant species in the family Lythraceae. This plant is traditionally used in Korean medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Korean cranesbill include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Korean cranesbill include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
